assumption: Captured Windows 10.0.29683 behavior owns class53 pointer, range and lifetime rules for this same-host implementation.
stress-test: Four ABIs, 16-byte outer access, BaseAddress then MaximumAddress inner field access, guards, invalid handles/lengths, overlap, descriptor/free/thread lifetime
falsification-probe: Any native row or installed-leaf result differs from the shared model.
history: Initial whole-prefix access assumption falsified by native first-page NOACCESS and two-guard controls.
Final model reads BaseAddress then MaximumAddress only; all three hosts pass the selected data-driven replay families and dedicated lifetime tests.

assumption: Removal selects the earliest remaining registration at an equal base before comparing its extent.
basis: native 0..12 duplicate sequences with and without neighboring intervals
stress-test: Empty duplicates followed by a nonempty equal-base range and alternating removals.
falsification-probe: Native removes a later extent while an earlier unequal extent remains.
validation: Captured sequence families replay unchanged on all three hosts.

assumption: The emulator admits at most 65536 live native dynamic ranges.
basis: host memory and scan cost require explicit admission control
dependent-result: At the explicit emulator quota, return STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES without changing state.
stress-test: Full quota, rejected addition, remove one and add one.
falsification-probe: Rejection changes the ledger or quota does not recover after deletion.
validation: The quota test preserves the ledger on rejection and permits admission after deletion on all three hosts.

assumption: Kernel range ownership is distinct from user-mode fixed function arrays and survives freeing either the descriptor or its range.
basis: ordinary type3 record with one zero array entry
dependent-result: No VM-free hook and no accidental admission into fixed-array unwind lookup.
stress-test: Free descriptor/range, retain overlapping refusal, remove through a new descriptor, share through another thread.
falsification-probe: Native deletion or lookup demonstrates automatic range removal or requires fixed-array registration.
